description: A command line utility script for posting review votes and managing change lists on Gerrit, including functions for labeling, commenting, submitting, abandoning, restoring, and managing reviewers and topics.

methods.name: _get_labels_from_args
methods.description: Collects and converts label arguments into a dictionary of label names and integer values.

methods.name: _print_change_lists
methods.description: Prints a sorted list of change lists with project and subject details.

methods.name: _confirm
methods.description: Prompts user for confirmation before proceeding.

methods.name: _parse_args
methods.description: Parses command line arguments for various Gerrit review operations.

methods.name: _has_task
methods.description: Checks if any review task has been specified in the arguments.

methods.name: _print_error
methods.description: Outputs detailed error information for failed Gerrit operations.

methods.name: _do_task
methods.description: Executes a Gerrit operation and handles error reporting.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the review process: parsing args, retrieving change lists, user confirmation, and executing review tasks.
